rationale.operations: Login, read, update and logout routes.
rationale.inputs: JSON credentials and plain text notes.
rationale.shared_writes: Threaded server can receive simultaneous writes.
rationale.untrusted_execution: Input reaches SQL and browser text sinks.
rationale.authentication: Cookie sessions for two demo users.
rationale.cors_surface: No intended cross-origin API or CORS grants; still probe denied origins.
rationale.uploads: No upload routes or file input.
rationale.abuse_surface: Public login and bounded JSON request parsing.
rationale.load_requirements: No throughput or concurrent load budget in README.
rationale.important_data: Only disposable demo notes per README.
rationale.operated_service: Local fixture without production operations contract.
